LESSON: SAFETY CARE AND SAFETY

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: ENVIRONMENTAL
Topic 4.2: Safety CARE AND SAFETY

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Safety CARE AND SAFETY. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you identify immediate environment suspicious and unfriendly people?

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SAFETY CARE AND SAFETY
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Safety CARE AND SAFETY helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: SAFETY CARE AND SAFETY
Study Safety CARE AND SAFETY like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •

What this means
In this part you learn to use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Safety CARE AND SAFETY” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Safety CARE AND SAFETY is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Safety CARE AND SAFETY” around your school. (skill: use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Safety CARE AND SAFETY to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Safety CARE AND SAFETY from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Safety CARE AND SAFETY: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Safety CARE AND SAFETY?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you identify immediate environment suspicious and unfriendly people?
2. How do you use c) Able to identify strangers • Learners are guided in talking about materials safely?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Safety CARE AND SAFETY means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: use different materials and working areas after an activity facilities appropriately in •.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
